name: Button
description: A clickable push button or checkbox.

conditions.description: Triggered when the button is clicked.
True if the checkbox is checked.

text-to-compare.name: Text to compare
text-to-compare.desc: Enter the text to compare with the button text.

case-sensitivity.name: Case sensitivity
case-sensitivity.desc: Choose whether capital letters count as different to lowercase.  If ignoring case, "ABC" matches "abc".

text.name: Text
text.desc: The text to set in the button.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: The tooltip to set on the button.

type.name: Type
type.desc: The kind of button to use.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The initial text for the button.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: Display this text when hovering the mouse over the control.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose if the object is visible when the layout starts.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the button is enabled or disabled on startup.

auto-font-size.name: Auto font size
auto-font-size.desc: Automatically set the font size depending on the layer scale.

checked.name: Checked
checked.desc: For checkboxes, the initial check state.

id.name: ID
id.desc: An optional ID for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.

class.name: Class
class.desc: An optional class for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.
